sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Michele is a playable Unit in the game. She is a daughter of a prominent aristocrat named Brandol who lives in an estate in Lizeria. She is a self-centered and spoiled girl who is determined to destroy the Ten-Winged Tormentor that laid many cities of Lizeria to waste.

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content: Michele first appeared in the storyline in the Grand Quest 'The Ten-Winged Tormentor'.

sections.title: In the storyline
sections.content:
Before the Great War between humanity and the gods, Michele came across a machine from another world known as Duel-GX. She learnt that the robot's mission was to eliminate what destroyed it's home world, Melchio. Having decided to fulfil its mission, it went off to search for comrades to defeat Melchio, subsequently nicknaming Duel-GX 'Crabby'.

Having founded her battalion, they came across Melchio. Although they attempted to fight the Ten-Winged Tormentor, they were all able to defeat him until he was granted a source of light which made him stronger even further. Despite the imminent danger the group faced, Michele pointed out her comrade's flaws individually as she attempted to fight Melchio alone.

After Duel-SGX sacrificed itself to destroy Melchio, a vortex appeared and Michele, grabbing a piece of Duel-SGX's fragment, bid her farewell to her comrades and entered the vortex, with the hope that she could restore Duel-SGX. She later arrived at the world where Duel GX's creator used to live, but it has been destroyed due to Melchio's rage before it arrived in Lizeria. According to SCOUT-F03, Michele lived in Bectas for a while to rebuild the world, before she passed away. She also left her axe in her sepulcher to reward whoever manages to find it.

sections.title: Personality
sections.content: Having been raised in an aristocratic family, Michele had grown up being very self-centered and spoiled. However, she has also a bad temper towards her comrades due to the determination she had which the others did not, as seen when she attempted to fight Melchio on her own after he gained strength from a source of light.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Michele's age when she was first introduced was 22 years old.
- Michele's birthday is April 1.
